No setup guide for this app

Composio is an integration platform, not an OAuth provider.

WHAT IT IS
Composio is an integration platform that connects your users' accounts to external services and manages their authentication credentials for your agents and tools.
AUTH IT USES
Project API key
x-api-key header
WHAT TO DO INSTEAD
There's no OAuth app to register with the platform itself. If they need OAuth credentials for a specific app it connects to, they register an app with that provider; otherwise they can use the platform's own API key and its managed auth.
